Goons barge into Madhvi's house and threaten her to sign the property papers. Dhruv tells the police that Madhvi had an affair with Ajay and Shilpa used to insult Ajay. Investigation reveals that Madhvi's uncle was in love with Madhvi and wanted to marry her. So, he killed Ajay and Madhvi.

The Lucknow police receive a call of a corpse being found by the river. The identity of the corpse says, Anmol Yadav. The police begin their investigation which leads them to a pattern.
